7.15pm Sathvik facing the first ball. The stands look packed. Gowtham Thamarai has the ball. 7.12pm We should be underway soon... News from elsewhere… Manu Bhaker created history today, becoming the first Indian to win multiple Olympic medals at the same edition. But it's just the start. If Abhinav Bindra's gold inspired a generation to pick up a gun and Neeraj Chopra's win told a nation to believe in itself, what Bhaker has done is raised the bar . Impact players
Kovai Kings: Atheeq Ur Rahman, R Divakar, Ram Arvindh, P Vidyuth
Tiruppur Tamizhans: Karthik Saran, M Mathivannan, T Natarajan, R Ram Kumar 7pm Looking at the individuals, wicketkeeper-batter Raheja has been a player to watch this season. He is second on the run-scorers' chart, with 261 runs from seven innings, striking at 147.45. Shahrukh Khan has been the star for Kovai Kings. He has 222 runs from six innings, with a strike rate of 191.37. That's way ahead of anyone who has scored at least 150 runs. Shahrukh has also chipped in with the ball - he has 11 wickets from seven bowling innings, and has an economy rate of 5.30. He will be a Player-of-the-Tournament contender for sure, especially if Kovai Kings get to the final. Kovai Kings, of course, have lost just two games across the last two seasons and are favourites to win a hat-trick of titles. And their trump card, my colleague Deiva Muthu tells me, will be Jhatavedh Subramanyan, the Hong Kong-born legspinner who was with SRH in IPL 2024. Read more about him here. zayan: "Hi Shamya... Lovely to see ball by ball coverage for the playoffs. Why don't we have these in the league stage??" - Thanks, Zayan. Let's see if we can start sooner next season :) Tiruppur Tamizhans' T Natarajan is another bowler who has had a good time this TNPL. He has 12 wickets - third on the table at this stage, with Shahrukh at fourth - from six bowling innings. He has been on the expensive side, though, bowling the trickier overs and going at 7.76. Not bad by any stretch, of course. And it's fantastic to see him bowling well consistently again. He did well at the IPL this year, too, if you remember. He was the sixth-highest wicket-taker with 19 wickets from 14 innings. Tiruppur Tamizhans are in the playoffs for the first time in the TNPL. And they have gotten here despite missing Vijay Shankar because of an injury. Natarajan and R Sai Kishore have stepped up for them. Sai Kishore himself was nursing an injury at the start of the season, but after completing his rehab at NCA, he took over as the captain and has led them into the knockouts. And he has a song for the occasion too. And they are promising to be very committed and very fearless. 6.45pm Toss: Tiruppur have won the toss and are batting first. Kovai: S Sujay, Suresh Kumar (wk), B Sai Sudharsanan, U Mukilesh, M Shahrukh Khan (capt), GV Vignesh, Mohammed Mohammed, M Siddharth, V Yudheeswaran, Jhathavedh Subramanyan, Gowtham Thamarai Kannan Tiruppur: Amit Sathvik, Tushar Raheja (wk), S Radhakrishnan, BS Anirudh, R Sai Kishore (capt), Mohamed Ali, S Ganesh, R Rohit, P Bhuvaneswaran, Ajith Ram, Maan Bafna So T Natarajan is not in the Tiruppur XI. You'd guess he will come in for Tiruppur's bowling innings. Possibly in place of Amit Sathvik, who was subbed out in the previous game, against Trichy Grand Cholas, or Mann Bafna, who hadn't started, but had come in for Sathvik and scored a crucial 35-ball 50. Kovai, meanwhile, have brought in GV Vignesh in place of Atheeq Ur Rahman, who had been subbed in for Gowtham Thamarai Kannan in the previous game, against Salem Spartans. 6.40pm We should have details from the toss and the line-ups soon. Not that you need reminding, but the third Sri Lanka vs India T20I is on today as well. There's been some weather around in Pallekele, but Deiva Muthu and Hemant Brar will keep you up to speed all through the evening. 6.30pm Hello. Welcome, everyone, to the live ball-by-ball coverage of Qualifier 1 of the 2024 Tamil Nadu Premier League, being played in Dindigul. To start with, the weather update, as always this time of the year: It's going to be cloudy. There is expected to be rain. The good news is that the really serious spells of rain are forecast for later in the evening. It's Q1, so we've got the top two teams of the league stage - Lyca Kovai Kings and IDream Tiruppur Tamizhans - with the losers of this game getting an additional chance of making the final, while today's winners go through to the title round directly. Kovai Kings were by far the most dominant team in the league stage, losing just one game and winning six to finish with 12 points from seven games. The one they lost was to Dindigul Dragons, who finished fourth on the table. As for Tiruppur Tamizhans, they won four and lost three, the same as the teams that finished third and fourth, and got the second place on the table because of their NRR, which wasn't too far behind Kovai Kings'. But when they met in the league, very early on in the competition, back on July 7, it was a very, very close affair, with Kovai Kings winning by just one run. Shahrukh Khan, their captain, was the star with the bat on that occasion, hitting a 32-ball 55. Mohammed Mohammed, who was otherwise quite expensive on the day, held his nerve to finish the job in the last over, conceding eight runs defending nine and picking up three wickets, including the big one of Tushar Raheja, who had led the chase with a 57-ball 81. That was a long time ago, though. Kovai Kings ran up a series of pretty comprehensive wins otherwise, till it came to their last game. That ended up being a last-ball finish, with M Siddharth hitting a four off the last ball to take them over the line.
